topics.label: Lecture opening and overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the introductory welcome and outlines the lecture's focus on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Innate pathogen recognition and pattern recognition receptor pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system detects infection and cellular damage through PAMPs, DAMPs, and pattern recognition receptor signaling cascades.

topics.label: Leukocyte recruitment, immune trafficking, and systemic inflammatory effects
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how sentinel cell activation directs leukocyte extravasation into tissues, lymphatic drainage to prime adaptive immunity, and potential progression to systemic septic shock.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic inflammatory outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the active and passive mechanisms that terminate inflammation, drive tissue healing, and lead to chronic responses or granuloma formation when triggers persist.

topics.label: Lecture closing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and announces the upcoming topic.
